description:
Apply patches to TPC-H dbgen source code to enable reliable stdout data generation
using the -z flag, matching the tpch-kit reference implementation.

The BenchBox TPC-H source (June 2021) lacks stdout output capability that was added
to tpch-kit (March 2025). This prevents streaming data generation workflows that
are critical for compression pipelines and efficient data loading.

Key differences identified between BenchBox and tpch-kit:
- Missing `zstdout` global variable declaration in dss.h
- Missing stdout conditional in print_prep() function in print.c
- Missing -z command-line flag handling in driver.c
- Money formatting bug in print.c (int vs long format specifier)
